sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "full_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "phone" TEXT, "language" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ml', "large_text" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "farms" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "district" TEXT, "settings" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "accepted_template_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "farm_members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "permissions" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX farm_members_user ON farm_members (user_id, farm_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "farm_invites" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "permissions" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "accepted_at" INTEGER, "accepted_by" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX farm_invites_farm ON farm_invites (farm_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "crops" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_ml" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_en" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'kg', "owner_farm_id" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX crops_owner ON crops (owner_farm_id, code)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "template_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "crop_id" TEXT, "list_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_ml" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_en" TEXT NOT NULL, "data" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, "template_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX template_items_list ON template_items (list_type, crop_id, sort_order)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "template_overrides" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope_id" TEXT, "template_item_id" TEXT, "crop_id" TEXT, "list_type" TEXT, "code" TEXT, "name_ml" TEXT, "name_en" TEXT, "data" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "hidden" INTEGER, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX template_overrides_farm ON template_overrides (farm_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "area" INTEGER, "area_unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cent', "tenure" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'owned', "details" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX plots_farm ON plots (farm_id, name) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "crop_cycles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plot_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "crop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "variety" TEXT, "plant_count" INTEGER, "area_share" INTEGER, "season" TEXT, "planted_on" TEXT, "started_on" TEXT, "ended_on" TEXT, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX crop_cycles_plot ON crop_cycles (plot_id, status) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX crop_cycles_farm ON crop_cycles (farm_id, status) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "crop_cycle_id" TEXT, "plot_id" TEXT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_on" TEXT, "done_at" INTEGER, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX tasks_farm_day ON tasks (farm_id, due_on, id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX tasks_cycle_day ON tasks (crop_cycle_id, due_on) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "noted_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "plot_id" TEXT, "crop_cycle_id" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX notes_farm_day ON notes (farm_id, noted_on, id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX notes_cycle_day ON notes (crop_cycle_id, noted_on) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "parties" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT, "notes" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX parties_farm ON parties (farm_id, kind, name) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT, "skill" TEXT, "wage_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'daily', "default_rate_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_family" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX workers_farm ON workers (farm_id, name) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "labour_groups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_named" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, "leader_worker_id" TEXT, "usual_size" INTEGER, "default_rates" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "notes" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX labour_groups_farm ON labour_groups (farm_id, label) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "labour_group_members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "worker_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX labour_group_members_group ON labour_group_members (group_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX labour_group_members_worker ON labour_group_members (worker_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "harvests" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "crop_cycle_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plot_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "harvested_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'kg', "grade_code" TEXT, "per_team_quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, "notes" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER, "waiting_override_reason" TEXT);
CREATE INDEX harvests_farm_day ON harvests (farm_id, harvested_on, id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX harvests_cycle_day ON harvests (crop_cycle_id, harvested_on) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "labour_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "work_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "worker_id" TEXT, "group_id" TEXT, "crop_cycle_id" TEXT, "plot_id" TEXT, "harvest_id" TEXT, "task_code" TEXT, "rate_class" TEXT, "head_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "attendance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1000 CHECK (attendance BETWEEN 0 AND 1000), "wage_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'daily', "hours" INTEGER, "overtime_hours" INTEGER, "overtime_rate_paise" INTEGER, "rate_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "piece_quantity" INTEGER, "piece_unit" TEXT, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "amount_overridden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER, CHECK(worker_id IS NOT NULL OR group_id IS NOT NULL));
CREATE INDEX labour_entries_farm_day ON labour_entries (farm_id, work_date, id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX labour_entries_cycle_day ON labour_entries (crop_cycle_id, work_date) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX labour_entries_worker_day ON labour_entries (worker_id, work_date) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX labour_entries_group_day ON labour_entries (group_id, work_date) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX labour_entries_harvest ON labour_entries (harvest_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "labour_allocations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "labour_entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "crop_cycle_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_manual" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX labour_allocations_entry ON labour_allocations (labour_entry_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX labour_allocations_cycle ON labour_allocations (crop_cycle_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "labour_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "paid_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "worker_id" TEXT, "group_id" TEXT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cash', "notes" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER, CHECK(worker_id IS NOT NULL OR group_id IS NOT NULL));
CREATE INDEX labour_payments_farm_day ON labour_payments (farm_id, paid_on, id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX labour_payments_worker_day ON labour_payments (worker_id, paid_on) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX labour_payments_group_day ON labour_payments (group_id, paid_on) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "spent_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "plot_id" TEXT, "vendor_party_id" TEXT, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cash', "due_on" TEXT, "notes" TEXT, "photo_path" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER);

CREATE INDEX expenses_plot_day ON expenses (plot_id, spent_on) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE INDEX expense_allocations_expense ON expense_allocations (expense_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX expense_allocations_cycle ON expense_allocations (crop_cycle_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "expense_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "paid_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cash', "notes" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX expense_payments_farm_day ON expense_payments (farm_id, paid_on, id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX expense_payments_expense ON expense_payments (expense_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "crop_cycle_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "harvest_id" TEXT, "label" TEXT, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'kg', "grade_code" TEXT, "teams_stamp" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER);

CREATE INDEX lots_harvest ON lots (harvest_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sales" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sold_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "buyer_party_id" TEXT, "sale_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'trader', "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'kg', "grade_code" TEXT, "rate_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deductions" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "net_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payment_due_on" TEXT, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cash', "notes" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER);

CREATE INDEX sale_payments_farm_day ON sale_payments (farm_id, received_on, id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX sale_payments_sale ON sale_payments (sale_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "other_income" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "received_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "crop_cycle_id" TEXT, "notes" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX other_income_farm_day ON other_income (farm_id, received_on, id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX other_income_cycle_day ON other_income (crop_cycle_id, received_on) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "market_prices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT, "crop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "grade_code" TEXT, "market" TEXT NOT NULL, "price_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'kg', "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "published_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX market_prices_crop ON market_prices (crop_id, market, published_at) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "price_alerts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "crop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "market" TEXT, "threshold_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'above', "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX price_alerts_crop ON price_alerts (crop_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "input_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "template_item_id" TEXT, "name_ml" TEXT, "name_en" TEXT, "category_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fertiliser', "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'kg', "pack_size" INTEGER, "reorder_level" INTEGER, "waiting_days" INTEGER, "notes" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER, CHECK(template_item_id IS NOT NULL OR name_ml IS NOT NULL OR name_en IS NOT NULL));
CREATE INDEX input_items_farm ON input_items (farm_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "input_applications" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "applied_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plot_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "crop_cycle_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "method_code" TEXT, "worker_id" TEXT, "group_id" TEXT, "waiting_days" INTEGER, "dose" TEXT, "notes" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX input_applications_farm_day ON input_applications (farm_id, applied_on, id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX input_applications_cycle_day ON input_applications (crop_cycle_id, applied_on) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "moved_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity <> 0), "expense_id" TEXT, "application_id" TEXT, "batch" TEXT, "expires_on" TEXT, "reason" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER, CHECK(kind <> 'purchase' OR(quantity > 0 AND expense_id IS NOT NULL)), CHECK(kind <> 'application' OR(quantity < 0 AND application_id IS NOT NULL)), CHECK(kind <> 'adjustment' OR(expense_id IS NULL AND application_id IS NULL)));
CREATE INDEX stock_movements_item_day ON stock_movements (item_id, moved_on) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX stock_movements_farm_day ON stock_movements (farm_id, moved_on, id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX stock_movements_expense ON stock_movements (expense_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX stock_movements_application ON stock_movements (application_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "soil_tests" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plot_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tested_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "lab" TEXT, "results" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "photo_path" TEXT, "notes" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX soil_tests_plot_day ON soil_tests (plot_id, tested_on) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "summary" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "old_values" TEXT, "new_values" TEXT, "occurred_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT);
CREATE INDEX event_log_farm_day ON event_log (farm_id, occurred_on, created_at, id)
CREATE INDEX event_log_entity ON event_log (entity, entity_id, created_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "batch_id" TEXT, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX outbox_queue ON outbox (status, created_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX outbox_pending ON outbox (entity, row_id) WHERE status = 'pending'
CREATE INDEX outbox_row ON outbox (entity, row_id, status)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "cursor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "pulled_at" INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(farm_id, entity));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "conflicts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "fields" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "mine" TEXT, "theirs" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "resolved_at" INTEGER, "resolution" TEXT);
CREATE INDEX conflicts_open ON conflicts (farm_id, created_at) WHERE resolved_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "photo_uploads" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "farm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_path" TEXT, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX photo_uploads_queue ON photo_uploads (status, created_at)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "value" TEXT NOT NULL);
